prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes and was sideswiped by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently under medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you, your insured, or any agent acting on your behalf.

We request that you provide the complete liability and coverage information for the policy applicable to the at-fault driver, including the declared bodily injury and property damage policy limits, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes, without limitation, photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, telematics or dashcam data, recorded statements, claim notes, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.

We look forward to your prompt response.
